comment: Per-case overrides for the golden-image corpus. Populated in Phase 4 (tests/cases/**). Consumed by tests/tools/bless.py (regenerate baselines), tests/tools/run_cases.py (the gated CTest test wxlunasvg_cases) and, via the expectedStatus field, the corpus tracker. The C++ engine (tests/support/compare.{h,cpp}) takes explicit options, so this file needs no C++ JSON parser.
caseKeyBase: Paths are relative to the repository root, e.g. tests/cases/bugs/bug_001_foo.
blessPlatformNote: Baselines are only ever blessed on Linux CI (plan decision 2b #12). tests/tools/bless.py refuses to run elsewhere without --allow-foreign-platform.

fieldNotes.background: 8-digit RRGGBBAA background colour passed to renderToBitmap; 00000000 is transparent.
fieldNotes.checkAlpha: false compares RGB only (RGBSimilarTo); true compares RGBA (RGBASimilarTo).
fieldNotes.maxDelta: Hard cap on the worst differing-channel delta (255 disables the cap).
fieldNotes.maxDifferingPixelRatio: Largest tolerated fraction of differing pixels.
fieldNotes.expectedStatus: pass | known-fail | skip; tracked per case and enforced by tests/tools/run_cases.py (and honoured by bless.py, which never blesses a skipped case).
fieldNotes.skipReason: Only meaningful when expectedStatus is 'skip': why the case is not exercised.

exact.description: Flat fills and geometry: every decoded pixel must agree.

antialiased.description: Small per-channel tolerance for anti-aliased edges only, with a cap so a whole-region regression still fails.

coverageGap: Text-bearing vectors are excluded from the golden set (plan decision 2b #9/§4): LUNASVG_DISABLE_LOAD_SYSTEM_FONTS makes host fonts unavailable but lunasvg still has no bundled-font-file API, so text rendering is not yet deterministic across platforms.

tests/cases/features_svg12/filters/filte.skipReason: text vector: excluded from the golden set until lunasvg gains a font-file API (plan decision 2b #9)

tests/cases/filters/composite_ops.skipReason: text vector: excluded from the golden set until lunasvg gains a font-file API (plan decision 2b #9)

tests/cases/filters/color_matrix.skipReason: text vector: excluded from the golden set until lunasvg gains a font-file API (plan decision 2b #9)

tests/cases/filters/blend_modes.skipReason: text vector: excluded from the golden set until lunasvg gains a font-file API (plan decision 2b #9)

tests/cases/security/sec_001_integer_ove.skipReason: canvas-size integer overflow; not rendered until the hardening lands

tests/cases/security/sec_002_deep_nestin.skipReason: 150-level nesting may overflow the stack; not rendered until the hardening lands

tests/cases/security/sec_003_excessive_p.skipReason: 100k+ path segments may exhaust memory or hang; not rendered until the hardening lands

tests/cases/security/sec_004_redos_css.skipReason: pathological CSS selector may hang; not rendered until the hardening lands

tests/cases/security/sec_005_use_recursi.skipReason: 50-level <use> recursion may overflow the stack; not rendered until the hardening lands

tests/cases/security/sec_006_xxe_entity.skipReason: external entity / XXE probe; must not read local files

tests/cases/security/sec_007_base64_deco.skipReason: oversized base64 data URI may over-allocate; not rendered until the hardening lands

tests/cases/security/sec_008_gradient_st.skipReason: 1000 gradient stops; not rendered until the hardening lands

tests/cases/security/sec_009_font_loadin.skipReason: system font path probing; not rendered until the hardening lands
